type:
∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
      let L := fun j : J => Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let a := α⁻¹
      let b := fun j : J => β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹
      let left := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) a
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let right := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H) (b j)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let crossingDot := fun {S : Subgroup U} (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd)) from
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * c) (β * d)
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change α * (c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change β * (d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            hs
      let dot := fun j : J =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (left j))
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (right j)) from
          crossingDot a (b j)
            (fun ℓ => (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (left j) ℓ).property)
            (fun ℓ => (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (right j) ℓ).property)
            (by
              change (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ ∈ G
              have hs : (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ = (σ j : U) := by
                group
              rw [hs]
              exact (σ j).property)
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (left j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (right j))
      let W := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
      let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
      let eval := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
          (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
      (∀ (S : Subgroup U) (ec : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S K)
          (ed : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S H),
        let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ed)
        let WL := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML
        ∀ (p : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W WL)
          (ι : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex WL W),
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical p ι = eval straight →
            ∃ j₀ : J, ∀ i : J, i = j₀) ∧
      (∀ (S : Subgroup U) (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let ec := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc
        let ed := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd
        let δ := crossingDot c d hc hd hs
        let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element δ
        let replyDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse δ
        let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ed)
        let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
        let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
        let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex (conjSubgroup (α * c) S) Ls
        let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ec ed δ
        let finiteFibers := ∀ z : W.carrier, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
        let cupFinite := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ed))
        let isTransversal := fun T : Set H => ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H,
          t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ed)
        let traceArg := fun (g : G) (t : H) =>
          g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ t)⁻¹ *
            (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element replyDot)
        let survives := fun (T : Set H) (g : G) =>
          {t | t ∈ T ∧ traceArg g t ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)}
        ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCapBasis ed w = h}) ↔ cupFinite) ∧
        (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
        (∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit j → ¬ finiteIndex →
          Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
        (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection eα eβ ec ed
              [(1, ⟨δ, hf⟩)] MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.cupAndMerge
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.splitAndTrace
          ∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G,
            ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g),
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval p)
                  (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset ht) (fun t =>
                  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction ed)
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))
                    (Finsupp.single t 1)))) ∧
      (∀ j : J, (∀ i : J, i = j) →
        ∃ hf : ∀ z : W.carrier,
            Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ
              (left j) (right j) (dot j) w = z},
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ (left j) (right j)
              [(1, ⟨dot j, hf⟩)]
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (left j) (right j)
              [(1, dot j)]
          eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι) = eval straight)
sourceReason: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 5.1, p. 18, after Proposition 5.3, with the reverse-cup and surviving-trace convention on p. 16. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction for this endpoint. The owner’s 27 November 2026 clarification in input.request (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the dot language. The necessity clause quantifies over arbitrary bimodule maps through any pair of intermediate conjugation embeddings, including boundaries whose only eligible finite label is zero. The full Mackey intersection uses coefficient-one singleton labels. The expanded reverse crossing inserts the inverse group element in the typed cup, merge, dot, split and trace scope. Finite surviving support governs that scope independently of the finite-index condition for a standalone reverse cup. The endpoint type elaborated through the shared Lean compilation slot.
